Thursday, November 1, 2018
We will announce on Sunday night Beijing time the JamesSuckling.com Wine of the Year 2018. We are going to give you a hint of what this fabulous wine is in this video. It’s a superb 2015 Bordeaux from either Pomerol or St. Emilion. The video highlights each estate and features interviews with winemakers and owners. Which one do you think wins Wine of the Year 2018?
